purpose: Frozen reduced HAT decomposition, fixed bar-hold representation, and the resulting numeric HAT and HAT+bar inertial properties.

decisions.value: head + upper trunk + middle trunk + 2x upper arm + 2x forearm + 2x hand (pelvis excluded and carried by the root pelvis body)
decisions.notes: HAT mass 38.7969 kg equals the Linear authority value 38.7969 kg.

decisions.statement: Fixed bar-hold posture parameterization (inertia aggregation reference posture).

value.elbow_rule: two-link IK in the vertical plane through shoulder and wrist; select the solution with the lower elbow z

decisions.locator: de Leva component geometry; frozen engineering bar-hold pose
decisions.notes: Every unmeasured posture parameter is engineering nominal with mandatory sensitivity; none is anthropometric truth.

decisions.locator: sum of de Leva mass fractions

decisions.statement: Aggregated HAT COM in the HAT frame (origin MIDH).
decisions.locator: de Leva component masses (LITERATURE_DIRECT) aggregated under the frozen engineering bar-hold posture UB-02
decisions.notes: The component masses are literature-direct; the aggregate COM inherits the engineering posture classification and is not an anthropometric measurement.

decisions.statement: Aggregated HAT inertia tensor about its COM (full 3x3, HAT frame).
decisions.locator: de Leva component tensors (LITERATURE_DIRECT) rotated into the HAT frame and translated under the frozen engineering bar-hold posture UB-02
decisions.sensitivity: covered by UB-02 perturbations; system Iyy range [1.73167341, 2.02437733] kg m^2 over the declared set
decisions.notes: Ixy=Iyz=0 by left-right symmetry; Ixz is non-zero and must not be silently dropped.

decisions.statement: HAT principal moments and principal rotation.
decisions.locator: eigendecomposition of UB-05 (which inherits the engineering posture classification)
decisions.notes: The principal rotation is small (~1.4 deg); a diagonal implementation is permitted only with this declared rotation or with the full tensor.

decisions.statement: Bar local placement relative to the HAT frame.
decisions.locator: upper-back/shoulder-girdle placement, posterior of the trunk axis
decisions.sensitivity: placement sensitivity +/- [0.025, 0.025] m in x and z
decisions.notes: RES-83 must not silently move the nominal; any change is an authority amendment.

decisions.statement: Combined HAT+bar mass, COM and inertia about the combined COM.
decisions.locator: rigid HAT (engineering posture) and rigid bar at the engineering placement UB-07; combination uses exact parallel-axis identity
decisions.notes: The sagittal-plane relevant inertia is Iyy = 1.86080482 kg m^2; transverse (pitch-axis) values are larger because of the 2.2 m bar.

decisions.locator: geometric consequence of frozen hand placement and published arm lengths
decisions.sensitivity: covered by grip-width and wrist-offset sensitivity
decisions.notes: The reduced HAT inertially represents a fixed bar-hold; it is not a claim about achievable articulated elbow angles.

decisions.statement: No arm swing, no bar roll, no bar compliance.
decisions.value: arms/hands rigidly attach to the bar; bar is rigidly attached to HAT in V1; sleeve rotation, bar flex and hand compliance are outside V1
decisions.notes: Any future arm-swing or bar-compliance variant is a new model revision.

decisions.value: SYSTEM_COM (athlete + rigid bar, 99 kg) is the primary mechanics authority; ATHLETE_COM is secondary/report-only
decisions.locator: carried-bar closure of the airborne system
decisions.notes: Force-impulse and ballistic identities use SYSTEM_COM and 99 kg.
